summary: CWE-397: the bad() method declared 'throws Throwable', an overly generic exception type that hides the actual error contract. Since an override may narrow the declared checked exceptions, I changed the declaration to 'throws FileNotFoundException' — the only checked exception the method body can actually produce (from the FileInputStream constructor; the close() call already catches its IOException). This preserves the feature and remains compatible with the abstract AbstractTestCase.bad() signature.
